domain: architectural ritual or investigative narrative with an uncluttered arm-waist region

candidate_constraints.subject: one original adult woman
candidate_constraints.composition_test: a visibly uncluttered region between an arm and the waist

candidates.title: Compass Audit in the Brass Archive Stair
candidates.concept: An adult architectural conservator in a buttoned charcoal field suit checks whether a spiral archive stair was built off-axis, sighting a pocket compass against repeating brass rails while one elbow opens away from her waist and the pale stone wall remains visible through the gap.

candidates.title: Salt-Line Evidence in a Flooded Courthouse
candidates.concept: An adult forensic surveyor in a fully fastened olive rain coat and work trousers reconstructs a vanished waterline inside an abandoned courthouse, comparing crystalline salt marks with a glass level while a clean section of tiled wall is framed between her arm and waist.

candidates.title: Noon Alignment at the Monolithic Sundial
candidates.concept: An adult heritage astronomer in a complete indigo utility uniform performs a quiet noon alignment ritual beside a monumental concrete sundial, lifting a slim sighting card with her elbow held clear of her torso so blue sky is continuous through the arm-waist opening.

candidates.title: Echo Trace in the Subterranean Vault
candidates.concept: An adult acoustic investigator in a high-neck rust field jacket and matching trousers maps an unexplained resonance in a ribbed underground chamber, releasing a linen marker ribbon while her outer arm forms an uncluttered aperture onto the chalky vault wall beside her waist.

candidates.title: Meridian Dispute at the Abandoned Observatory
candidates.concept: An adult investigator in a fully buttoned cobalt survey coat and dark trousers tests a disputed meridian inside a derelict civic observatory, comparing a suspended brass plumb line with a narrow sunbeam while her raised right elbow creates a crisp triangular view of uninterrupted plaster wall between her actual arm and waist contours.

candidates.title: Shadow Index in the Circular Library
candidates.concept: An adult building historian in a fully closed cream work jacket and wide-leg trousers catalogs a moving window shadow across a circular library, holding a translucent indexing plate outward so the warm bookcase background reads cleanly through the space between her left arm and waist.

candidates.title: Tide-Clock Reading in the Stone Cistern
candidates.concept: An adult infrastructure researcher in a complete slate-blue coverall deciphers a carved tide clock inside a dry masonry cistern, comparing a hand lamp with calibrated wall notches while a broad dark arch remains continuously visible in the opening between her bent arm and waist.

candidates.title: Frost-Grid Reconstruction in the Glasshouse
candidates.concept: An adult materials investigator in a zipped burgundy field jacket and straight trousers reconstructs a failed heating grid in a winter glasshouse, raising a transparent diagram away from her torso so frosted panes remain plainly visible through the clean arm-waist interval.

selected_title: Meridian Dispute at the Abandoned Observatory
